narratives.Description: AppSec review found four MEDIUM symlink / confused-deputy sinks where committed or force-addable leaf or directory symlinks divert `writeFileSync`, `appendFileSync`, or mkdir materialization outside the project under the operator identity. Prior work already ships `assertWriteTargetSafe` / `projectionTarget` in `packages/core/src/fs/projection-containment.ts`. This story gates the four remaining CLI paths and adds symlink-diversion regression tests for each.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Guard `writeHealthBaseline` in `packages/core/src/eval-health-relocation/evaluate.ts`, `recordLastSubmit` in `packages/core/src/product-signal/submit.ts`, and the uninstall AGENTS.md rewrite plus `change:init` history materialization in `packages/core/src/task-surface/index.ts` with `assertWriteTargetSafe` / `projectionTarget` before mutate. 2. Extend focused tests in `evaluate.test.ts`, `submit.test.ts`, and `task-surface/index.test.ts` (reusing patterns from `projection-containment.test.ts`) so symlink-at-leaf and directory diversion are rejected with a clear error and no outside write. 3. Record a short pattern-audit note in the PR for any remaining same-trust-class writers that need a follow-up issue or intentional exception.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive operator running CLI tasks, I want write sinks to reject symlink diversion outside the project, so that automation cannot overwrite or append files under a confused-deputy path.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

AppSec review against commit `c7fc6df9` found **4 MEDIUM** symlink / confused-deputy write sinks with end-to-end CLI paths.

### Findings
1. `eval-health-relocation/evaluate.ts` — seed-baseline overwrite via symlink
2. `product-signal/submit.ts` — last-submit append via symlink
3. `task-surface/index.ts` — uninstall AGENTS.md rewrite via symlink
4. `task-surface/index.ts` — change:init history/ directory symlink escape

Related prior fix pattern: `assertWriteTargetSafe` / `projectionTarget` (`packages/core/src/fs/projection-containment.ts`).

items.title: Given a symlink at the eval-health baseline path, when seed-baseline runs, then the outside target is rejected.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a committed symlink at `xbrief/.eval/results/eval-health-baseline.json` pointing outside the project, when `task verify:eval-health-relocation -- --seed-baseline` runs, then the write is rejected with a clear containment error and the outside target is not overwritten.

items.title: Given a symlink at product-signal last-submit path, when submit records metadata, then the outside append is rejected.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a force-addable symlink at `.deft-cache/product-signal-last-submit.json` pointing outside the project, when a successful `task product-signal:submit` records last-submit metadata, then the append is rejected with a clear containment error and the outside target is not appended.

items.title: Given AGENTS.md or history/ symlinks, when uninstall or change:init runs, then outside rewrite or materialization is rejected.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a repo `AGENTS.md` symlink or an escaping `history/` directory symlink, when `task install:uninstall` rewrites AGENTS.md or `task change:init` materializes `history/changes/<name>/`, then the operation rejects the diverted target and does not overwrite or create files outside the project root.

items.title: Given the four gated sinks, when regression tests run, then each symlink diversion path is covered.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the four gated write/append/mkdir sinks, when the focused vitest suites run, then symlink diversion coverage exists for eval-health baseline seed, product-signal last-submit append, uninstall AGENTS.md rewrite, and change:init history materialization.

expected_outputs: symlink diversion tests pass for all four sinks
assertWriteTargetSafe guards at each mutate site
